factions.japan: Sengoku Japan: black-lacquered timber, white plastered walls, dark grey tiled roofs, plain white cloth banners without any emblem or marking, boxy atakebune and sekibune warships with loopholes.
factions.ming: Ming China: brick walls, red and yellow lacquered gate towers with yellow-glazed tiled roofs, plain red and yellow cloth banners without any emblem, large Chinese junk warships with batten sails.
